lea.text: Liana gave the Moxen to Kristina of the Woods and Jared during her duel with Ravidel so he would not take them.
At the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor, however, Ravidel used three of the Moxen to activate the Mox Beacon against Jared and his allies.

ice.text: Kristina of the Woods was trapped in the Shard on Dominaria during the Ice Age, where Taysir fell in love with her on Corondor and Leshrac summoned an elder dragon against her.
At the Summit of the Null Moon battle erupted among the planeswalkers, Ravidel and Rhuell died, and Kristina and Taysir resurrected Ravidel, who declared Kristina his enemy.
Kristina and Taysir then helped Freyalise cast the World Spell, ending the Ice Age and the Shard, and the two parted ways.
